name: OSCAR surface currents (1/3 deg, 5-day, 2011-12-06..2014-09-26)
licence: Free to use and redistribute, no warranty (ERDDAP dataset licence)
processing: Every 3rd grid point (1 deg), averaged by calendar month ignoring NaN, shifted to 1 deg cell centres by a NaN-aware 4-point mean, lon wrapped to -180..180, packed as int16 at 0.001 m/s in 12 DRFT tiles

name: QuikSCAT SeaWinds monthly 10 m winds (RSS science quality, 1999-08..2009-10)
licence: Free to use and redistribute, no warranty (ERDDAP dataset licence)
processing: Every 16th point (2 deg, 75S..75N), averaged by calendar month, monthly means over 25 m/s masked (sea-ice contamination), packed as int16 at 0.01 m/s in one 12-frame DRFT tile. Replaces the planned ICOADS climatology, which the ERDDAP server stopped serving

name: NOAA Global Drifter Program 6-hourly QC drifters, 2012-01-01..2014-09-26
processing: One fix per drifter-day, consecutive-day pairs with displacement under 300 km, windage = fix on/after drogue loss, joined to the sampled monthly current and wind fields; training pairs only (not shipped)

name: Natural Earth 1:50m land
processing: Polygons rasterised to a 2048x1024 equirectangular PNG, 255 = land
